description:
Full profile of one hotel by its hotel_id from search_hotels:
        description, amenities, images, rooms, guest reviews and guest
        insights. A price is included only when both check_in and check_out
        are given, as the all-inclusive total for that stay. parley_url is
        the hotel's page on Parley with the stay's dates, where the user can
        view live prices and book. Everything needed to describe the hotel
        is here; no web search needed. Works without an API key.

check_in.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (today or later). Prices need check_in and check_out.
check_in.title: Check In

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for prices, e.g. 'EUR', 'USD', 'GBP'.
currency.title: Currency

guests.description: Number of adult guests (0 = default of 2).
guests.title: Guests

hotel_id.description: The hotel's id (a UUID), as returned in hotel_id by search_hotels.
hotel_id.title: Hotel Id

rooms.description: Number of rooms (0 = 1). Prices are only quoted for one room.
rooms.title: Rooms

name: get_hotel_details
title: Get hotel details
